senses.en_definition: A personal given name, conventionally written Jemma; no standard Malay common-noun meaning is established here.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang dieja Jemma; takrif sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat disahkan.
senses.nuances: 这里记录的是有实例支持的人名用法，并非 DBP 官方释义，也无法确定输入词项的原始所指。皇家莎士比亚剧团的资料中可见姓名 Jemma Desai。以下搭配和情景是按人名用法编写的示例，不是已核实的高频搭配。[RSC：Jemma Desai](https://www.rsc.org.uk/news/new-fellows-explore-the-big-questions-facing-the-creative-and-cultural-sector)

etymology.historical_story: Jemma is attested as a personal name, including in the Royal Shakespeare Company's profile of Jemma Desai. That evidence establishes a naming use, not a Malay dictionary meaning or a historical derivation. Without context for this particular token, its language of origin, intended bearer and route into the supplied frequency list remain unverified.
